macros.name: luaSetBelongsto
macros.doc: Returns true if an element is in a set; otherwise, it returns false.

macros.name: luaSetCardinal
macros.doc: Gives the cardinality of a set (number of elements).

macros.name: luaSetDifference
macros.doc: Defines the new set as a difference of set1 and set2.

macros.name: luaSetEqual
macros.doc: Returns true if set1 is equal to set2; otherwise, it returns false.

macros.name: luaSetIntersection
macros.doc: Defines the new set as an intersection of set1 and set2.

macros.name: luaSetNew
macros.doc: A set can be defined by using the \luaSetNew command.

macros.name: luaSetPrint
macros.doc: The set can be displayed or printed by using the \luaSetPrint command.

macros.name: luaSetSubset
macros.doc: Returns true if set1 is a proper subset of set2; otherwise, it returns false.

macros.name: luaSetSubseteq
macros.doc: Returns true if set1 is a subset of set2; otherwise, it returns false.

macros.name: luaSetUnion
macros.doc: Defines the new set as a union of set1 and set2.
